 Order

This is a clear case where the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has exceeded its authority by not only laying the road on the Petitioner's land forcibly but also demolishing a portion of the petitioner's building despite several request.

2. The learned counsels for the Respondents would submit that the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) will give the details of the amounts of compensation due to the Petitioner under Act 30 of 2013 in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for the land acquired as well as the building demolished.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: _ __ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.
Heard the learned counsel on either side.

4. Under these circumstances, the Writ petition is allowed by directing the Respondents to fix the fair compensation price for the damages caused to the petitioner's land and building and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law and file a report of the same before this Court
Needless to state that the Petitioner shall be heard before passing such order.
In case of any rejection, a speaking order shall be passed.
This exercise shall be completed within a period of four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
